svg.data-coverage: One FHM supports up to 8 RUs; cascading can be used to extend coverage
svg.data-reach-qsfp28: 10 km max at 40/100G (HIG port overview, ports 12-13)
svg.data-operating-temp: -40 to 70 C (datasheet; HIG checklist says -40 to 65 C - see gaps)
svg.data-fpga: Intel Stratix 10 TX (O-RAN shared cell function)
svg.data-fronthaul: various fiber length delay compensation; configurable data compression mode, IQ data width and U/C plane VLAN ID
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 T-TC (G.8275.1; T-BC, T-GM and G.8264 ESMC available with future premium versions), Class C
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in, 1PPS SMB in/out, 10MHz SMB in/out, BITS RJ48 in/out, ToD RJ45 in/out
svg.data-gnss: GPS L1C/A, GLONASS L1OF, BeiDou B1, Galileo E1B/C; passive or active antenna auto-detected (active supply 5 V DC / 150 mA, min RF sensitivity -166 dBm); activated with a software license key on future premium versions
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER (datasheet supported accessories)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: none published - the QSFP28 ports are reserved and the datasheet's supported-accessories list carries only 10G SFP+ optics
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; EN 303 413; EN 301 489; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A; KS C 9832 Class A; KS C 9835

g.data-description: HIG GNSS row - Off (not configured), Solid Green (normal state, self-survey complete), Blinking Green (learning state, self-survey not completed), Solid Yellow (power up, not tracking any satellite), Blinking Yellow (antenna short to ground). Every row is annotated "Need NOS to activate this feature"
g.title: led-gnss

g.data-description: HIG SYNC row - Off (synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core, 1588 and SyncE, synchronized to an external source), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Yellow (acquiring or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail). All but Solid Yellow annotated "need NOS to activate this feature"
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG SYS row - Solid Green (system boot complete), Blinking Yellow (system boot not complete); Off, Blinking Green and Solid Yellow are all marked Reserved
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - Solid Green (all fan modules work well), Blinking Yellow (one or more fan modules fail or no fan module present); Off, Blinking Green and Solid Yellow are Reserved. The fans are fixed and drawn as rear decor, so this lamp names the chassis
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PWR row - Off (no power or in shutdown mode), Solid Green (system power good, BMC present and BMC power good), Solid Yellow (system power good, BMC absent)
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: HIG ID row - Off (no power), Blinking Blue (beacon feature is enabled on the switch)
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: led-mgmt1-l: HIG Management port LED table, left lamp - Off (1G no link), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); led-mgmt1-r: HIG Management port LED table, right lamp - Off (no activity), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity)
g.title: mgmt-1

g.data-description: led-mgmt2-l: HIG Management port LED table, left lamp - Off (1G no link), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); led-mgmt2-r: HIG Management port LED table, right lamp - Off (no activity), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity)
g.title: mgmt-2

circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no DC power to any PSU), Green (PSU DC output on and OK), Red (PSU failure), Flashing Green (DC present, only standby output on - poor contact), Flashing Red (no DC power to this PSU), Flashing between Green and Red (warning: working condition not satisfied, check voltage, current and temperature)
